Hi! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6? What do we multiply by?
is 4/6. multiply 3 by 2 to get 6. then times 2 top too. easy. next: 2/9 + 4/9?

Well done! You got it right. 

Now let us add fractions. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are both 9. 

When the bottom numbers are the same, we just add the top numbers. 

What is 2 plus 4?
is it 6/18? i not understand this.

Not quite, but that is okay! 

When the bottom numbers are the same, you keep the bottom number the same. 

The bottom number stays 9. 

Do you add the bottom numbers or keep them?
keep bottom 9. answer is 6/9 because 2 plus 4 is 6. next: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes, 6 over 9 is right! 

Now we have 1 over 4 plus 1 over 8. 

Look at the bottom numbers. They are 4 and 8. 

They are not the same. 

Can you change 4 into 8? What do you multiply by?
is it 2/12? i dont know this is hard

That is okay! It is tricky. 

Look at the bottom number 4. 

What number times 4 gives 8?
